Jamiu designed the original portfolio UI in Figma, then used AI-assisted vibe coding with ChatGPT/Codex to build and ship it. He directed its design, architecture, structure and implementation. Source code is maintained in GitHub and deployed on Vercel.

In this portfolio workflow, Jamiu applies engineering judgement to translating designs into working interfaces, structuring implementation and reusable components, and connecting interactions. AI coding assistance is acknowledged; neither an unaided manual build nor a separate development team is documented.
Current employment status, live availability, work eligibility and response time have not been confirmed. Historical project dates do not establish any of these.

The interface offers telephone and email links. It has no embedded video calls, live-presence indicator, booking calendar or contact form. A displayed button does not confirm a call, message or booking took place.

This separate search-style portfolio uses the same dark search layout on every project and supporting page. Search and AI chat stay on the left; selecting a project, About, Brand, Logos, Systems or Credentials opens its content in the right panel. On mobile the selected page fills the screen and Close returns to the results. It does not navigate to the previous published portfolio. The walkthrough remains removed.

Chat options includes Compare a role: visitors can paste a job description or upload a PDF or Word document, review the extracted text and compare requirements with documented experience. This is an evidence comparison, not a hiring verdict.

Search the portfolio using All, AI Mode, Images, Projects, Experience and Credentials. Project and supporting-page links stay inside this search-style portfolio. AI Mode has follow-up chat, New chat and Compare a role, with the input pinned at the bottom. The circular new-chat icon glows and rotates. Desktop visitors can drag the divider or use its arrow keys to resize the panels; double-click or Home restores the default split. Width preference is remembered locally. Phone and email links open the visitor's own apps. Voice search depends on browser support and permission.

The search-style homepage preview was adapted from a Google search UI reference supplied by Jamiu and implemented with AI coding assistance, reusing his existing portfolio content, suit portrait and agent. The original portfolio UI was designed in Figma; a Figma design step has not been documented for this new search-layout preview.
